task: There is RNA-seq 10X Cell Ranger data and BCR-seq data from 2 patients (use filtered contig annotations). You can find metadata related to the patients in the metadata.csv file. For each patient, two measurements were taken: one before influenza vaccination (e.g. 09-0) and the other 7 days after the vaccination (e.g. 09-7). Load the data, perform preprocessing and quality control. Remove cells with mitochondrial RNA content of 15% or more. Keep only cells with exactly one productive heavy chain and one productive light chain, and only cells for which both BCR and RNA-seq data exist. Annotate cell types using cell_type.py script. Across all pre-vaccination samples, among cells whose light chain uses IGKV4-1, which cell type is most common, not counting Naive B cells? Does this hold in each pre-vaccination sample separately? Output patient id in which it doesn't hold or '-' if it holds. What is the mean length, in amino acids, of the heavy-chain junction (including the conserved C and W) in plasmablasts across all samples? Which cell type has a higher fraction of cells whose heavy chain uses IGHJ6: Memory B cells or Plasma cells (across all samples)?
